description: This PHP file manages the reordering of test case steps in the TestLink project. It processes step sequence arguments, updates step numbering, and logs changes. It is used to update the order of test steps via an AJAX call.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP class used to instantiate simple objects for passing data, used here for storing arguments.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing the 'stepSeq' parameter from the request.
